authentication: Laravel Sanctum (token) — semua endpoint protected memakai Bearer token
hard_rules: Never trust price calculated by client.
Never trust order total from client.
additional_measures: Password di-hash (bcrypt) — tidak pernah disimpan plaintext
Konfigurasi sensitif (DB, payment, mail) hanya di environment variables
Rate limiting pada endpoint auth & checkout
Sanitasi input pada konten komunitas (XSS protection)
